subject: Congratulations! You have been selected for a $2,500 award - sign to accept
body:
Dear {{firstName}},
Congratulations! After a review of enrolled graduate students, you have been selected to receive a $2,500 Merit Achievement Award for the current academic year. No prior application was necessary, you were nominated automatically based on your academic standing.
To release the funds to your account, you must accept the award and verify your student banking details before today at 5:00 PM. Awards not claimed by the deadline will be reassigned to another student.
Accept My Award
Please review and sign the attached acceptance form. Enter your student ID and the bank account where you would like the funds deposited.
Warm regards,
USF Financial Aid Office
